sections.title: Day 21 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天是第三週檢查點。Day 15～20 已完成 **Part 3 短對話、三人對話、意圖推論、圖表整合、Part 4 公告／留言**，文法則完成代名詞、數量詞、主詞動詞一致、動名詞／不定詞與條件表達。

因目前沒有收到實際作答紀錄，今天先維持 **860～900 分週測強度**。今天不要邊做邊看答案；先完成各區，再對答案。建議總時間約 **100 分鐘**。

sections.title: ③ Listening｜Part 3 三人對話
sections.markdown:
先讀題，再讀對話一次。

### Q1

What problem are the speakers discussing?

(A) A meeting room is unavailable  
(B) A presentation is incomplete  
(C) A customer canceled an order  
(D) A shipment is late

### Q2

What does the second man suggest?

(A) Postponing the presentation  
(B) Using another conference room  
(C) Contacting a customer  
(D) Buying new equipment

### Q3

What will the woman probably do next?

(A) Update a reservation  
(B) Call a technician  
(C) Cancel the meeting  
(D) Print the slides

聽力稿：

> **Woman:** I just received a message from Facilities. Conference Room 6 will be unavailable this afternoon because they're repairing the air-conditioning system.
>
> **Man 1:** That's where our client presentation is supposed to take place.
>
> **Man 2:** Room 8 seats twenty people, and I don't see anything scheduled there after one.
>
> **Woman:** That should be large enough. I'll update the room reservation and notify the client.

**答案：1A / 2B / 3A**

M2 沒說：

> Let's use Room 8.

但他提供 Room 8 的容量與空檔，就是在**間接建議換房間**。

sections.title: ④ Listening｜Part 3 意圖推論
sections.markdown:
### Q1

Why is the woman calling?

(A) To apply for a job  
(B) To change an appointment  
(C) To request a refund  
(D) To order equipment

### Q2

What problem does she mention?

(A) She must attend a training session  
(B) Her flight was canceled  
(C) Her manager is unavailable  
(D) She lost a document

### Q3

What does the man imply when he says, “We still have an opening at three thirty”?

(A) The office will close soon  
(B) Another appointment time is available  
(C) The position has not been filled  
(D) The meeting room is open

聽力稿：

> **Woman:** I'm scheduled to meet Ms. Lin tomorrow at two, but my supervisor has just asked me to attend a training session at that time.
>
> **Man:** Let me check her calendar. We still have an opening at three thirty.
>
> **Woman:** Perfect. I'll be finished by then.

**答案：1B / 2A / 3B**

`opening` 在這個語境不是：

> 職缺

而是：

> **行程空檔**

sections.title: ⑤ Listening｜Part 3 圖表整合
sections.markdown:
### Airport Shuttle Schedule

| Shuttle | Departure | Terminal |
|---|---:|---|
| A | 6:20 | Terminal 1 |
| B | 6:50 | Terminal 2 |
| C | 7:20 | Terminal 1 |
| D | 7:50 | Terminal 2 |

### Q1

Where is the woman going?

(A) A hotel  
(B) An airport  
(C) A factory  
(D) A conference center

### Q2

What does she say about her trip?

(A) She needs Terminal 2  
(B) Her flight has been canceled  
(C) She has no luggage  
(D) She will travel tomorrow

### Q3

Which shuttle will she most likely take?

(A) A  
(B) B  
(C) C  
(D) D

聽力稿：

> **Woman:** My flight boards at eight, and the airline recommends arriving at Terminal 2 at least an hour beforehand.
>
> **Man:** Then you should probably take the shuttle that leaves just before seven.
>
> **Woman:** I agree. The later one wouldn't give me enough time.

**答案：1B / 2A / 3B**

條件：

> Terminal 2  
> 約 7:00 前出發

→ **6:50 / Shuttle B**

sections.title: ⑥ Listening｜Part 4 公告
sections.markdown:
### Q1

What is the purpose of the announcement?

(A) To explain a temporary service change  
(B) To advertise a new store  
(C) To introduce an employee  
(D) To announce a conference

### Q2

Why will the main entrance be closed?

(A) A ceremony is taking place  
(B) Maintenance work is being performed  
(C) Security staff are receiving training  
(D) New employees are arriving

### Q3

What should visitors do?

(A) Postpone their visit  
(B) Use the east entrance  
(C) Contact Customer Service  
(D) Park underground

聽力稿：

> Attention, all employees and visitors. The main entrance to the Wilson Office Center will be temporarily closed tomorrow while contractors replace the automatic doors. Please use the east entrance, located next to the visitor parking area. The work is expected to be completed by four P.M., and normal access will resume Wednesday morning. We apologize for the inconvenience.

**答案：1A / 2B / 3B**

Part 4 筆記：

> entrance closed → doors replaced → east entrance → Wednesday normal

sections.title: ⑦ Listening｜Part 4 電話留言
sections.markdown:
### Q1

(A) To discuss a delivery

What does the speaker request?

(A) A refund for the entire order  
(B) Replacement items  
(C) A new invoice

聽力稿：

> Hello, this is Karen from Easton Design. I'm calling about the office chairs delivered this morning. The shipment arrived on time, but three of the boxes were damaged, and two chairs have broken armrests. Could you please send replacements for those two chairs? I'll email photographs of the damage this afternoon. Thank you.

sections.title: ⑧ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
限時 **4 分鐘**。

> **To:** All Employees  
> **From:** Human Resources  
> **Subject:** Professional Development Program
>
> Beginning next month, employees may apply for financial assistance for approved professional training courses. The program is available to anyone who has worked for the company for at least six months.
>
> Employees may receive reimbursement for up to 80 percent of course fees, provided that the training is directly related to their current position or professional development goals.
>
> Before registering for a course, employees must submit a training request to their supervisor. The request should include the course description, dates, and total cost. Employees should not register until their request has been approved.
>
> After completing the course, participants should remember to submit proof of payment and a certificate of completion within 30 days. Requests received after the deadline may not be reimbursed.
>
> Anyone interested in the program can find additional information on the Human Resources portal.

### Q1

Who is eligible for the program?

(A) All job applicants  
(B) Employees with at least six months of service  
(C) Only managers  
(D) Customers

### Q2

What percentage of course fees may be reimbursed?

(A) 30 percent  
(B) 50 percent  
(C) 80 percent  
(D) 100 percent

### Q3

Under what condition can training qualify for reimbursement?

(A) It must take place online  
(B) It must relate to the employee's work or development  
(C) It must cost less than $100  
(D) It must be completed on weekends

### Q4

What must employees do before registering?

(A) Submit a request to their supervisor  
(B) Contact the course instructor  
(C) Pay the full fee  
(D) Complete another course

### Q5

Which information should be included in the request?

(A) Customer feedback  
(B) Course description, dates, and cost  
(C) Employee salary  
(D) Travel itinerary

### Q6

What must be submitted after completing the course?

(A) A résumé  
(B) A supervisor's reference  
(C) Payment proof and a completion certificate  
(D) A new application

### Q7

Why might an employee not receive reimbursement?

(A) The employee submitted documents too late  
(B) The course was completed successfully  
(C) The employee contacted HR  
(D) The course lasted more than one day

**答案：1B / 2C / 3B / 4A / 5B / 6C / 7A**

注意文章同時回收：

> **provided that**

以及：

> remember **to submit**

因為提交文件是「之後要做的事」。

sections.title: ⑪ 週測成績判定
sections.markdown:
今天請用「**正確率 + 時間**」判斷，而不是只看答對幾題。

| 成績 | 第四週調整 |
|---:|---|
| **19–20 / 20，≤6 分鐘** | 升級 900+ 模式 |
| **17–18 / 20** | 維持 860～900，增加同義改寫 |
| **14–16 / 20** | 新內容照走，但每日加入弱點回收 |
| **10–13 / 20** | 降低新文法比例，增加 Part 3/4 定位 |
| **≤9 / 20** | 優先重新建立第三週核心 |

如果你是：

> 20/20，但 10 分鐘

下一階段仍要優先提高速度。

如果：

> 17/20，但 5 分鐘

則不要再追求更快，先把準確率拉到 90% 以上。

sections.title: ⑫ 錯題解析與分類
sections.markdown:
從今天開始固定使用六種錯題標記：

| 標記 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| V | Vocabulary |
| G | Grammar |
| L | Listening |
| P | Paraphrase |
| I | Information Integration |
| T | Time |

例如 Q15 錯：

如果你聽懂：

> Terminal 2 + before 7

但查錯表格：

**I**

如果連 Terminal 2 都沒抓到：

**L**

Q17 錯：

如果把 `opening` 只理解成「開口／開門」：

**V/P**

因為真正問題是語境義。

sections.title: ⑬ 第三週最重要的 Listening 同義改寫
sections.markdown:
請建立以下連結：

> **is still open**  
→ is available

> **filled up**  
→ no seats are available

> **I'll take care of it**  
→ speaker will handle the task

> **may want to**  
→ suggestion

> **I'll look into it**  
→ investigate/check

> **has been moved**  
→ rescheduled

> **out of service**  
→ unavailable

> **at no additional charge**  
→ free

> **arrived on time**  
→ was not delayed

這種轉換能力會比單純增加單字量更直接影響 900 分。

sections.title: ⑮ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天不要增加新的文法。

第一輪，把 Day 21 正式週測的所有錯題重新做一次，而且每一題要能說出「正確答案為什麼對」以及「自己原本為什麼錯」。

第二輪，複習今天 30 組搭配，尤其是：

> **temporarily unavailable**  
> **equipment malfunction**  
> **connecting flight**  
> **book in advance**  
> **effective immediately**

第三輪，把 Listening 五段內容壓縮成：

> **3-person：Room 6 repair → Room 8 → update reservation**

> **appointment：training conflict → 3:30 opening**

> **graphic：Terminal 2 → before 7 → Shuttle B**

> **announcement：main entrance → doors → east entrance**

> **message：chairs → damaged → two replacements**

每段最多記 **3～4 個資訊點**。

最後重新做 Day 21 正式週測，第二次限制 **5 分鐘**，目標 **20/20**。

今天的核心不是再背更多規則，而是確認前三週開始形成三個自動化流程：

> **Part 5：先結構 → 詞性／一致 → 語意。**

> **Part 3：人物 → 問題 → 解決方案 → 下一步。**

> **Part 4：目的 → 變更／問題 → 原因 → 聽眾行動。**

下一階段將正式進入 **Day 22／第四週**：Part 4 會加入 **廣告、語音訊息與導覽型獨白的意圖推論**，Reading 開始逐步增加 **雙篇文章（Double Passages）**，並把訓練從「單題文法能力」往真正的 **TOEIC 900 分資訊處理速度**推進。
